details: Agents must exist as Dynamics 365 users
Agents require a Dynamics product license
Required roles include Customer Service Representative
Required roles include Customer Service app access
Open the Live Assist Admin Portal
Enable the agent using the yellow toggle
Supervisors can be enabled from the same user card
Supervisor access is controlled in the Admin Portal
Supervisor role provides Engagement Portal visibility
Do not manually assign Live Assist managed roles in Dynamics
Live Assist roles should only be managed from the Admin Portal
Manual role modification may break integrations
